items.title: Markdown: headings and emphasis
items.body:
# Heading 1
## Heading 2
### Heading 3

**bold**  *italic*  ~~strikethrough~~  `inline code`

> Blockquote

---   (horizontal rule)

items.title: Markdown: lists
items.body:
- Item
- Item
  - Nested item (indent 2 spaces)

1. First
2. Second
3. Third

items.title: Markdown: task lists
items.body:
- [x] Done
- [ ] To do
- [ ] Another task

items.title: Markdown: links and images
items.body:
[link text](https://example.com)
[link with title](https://example.com "Title")
![alt text](path/to/image.png)
[ref link][id]

[id]: https://example.com
<https://auto-link.example.com>

items.title: Markdown: code blocks
items.body:
```python
def hello():
    print("hi")
```

Inline: use `code` in a sentence.
Indent four spaces for an indented block.
items.description: Fenced block with a language for highlighting.

items.title: Markdown: tables
items.description: Pipes and dashes; colons set alignment.

items.title: Markdown: footnotes, collapsible, line breaks
items.body:
Text with a footnote.[^1]

[^1]: The footnote text.

<details>
<summary>Click to expand</summary>

Hidden content here.

</details>

End a line with two spaces or a backslash for a line break.

items.title: Markdown: escaping characters
items.body:
\*not italic\*   \# not a heading   1\. not a list   \[not a link\]
Use backticks to show Markdown syntax literally: `**bold**`

items.title: LaTeX: text formatting and lists
LaTeX: special characters
items.body:
\%  \&  \_  \#  \$  \{  \}
Quotes: ``double''  `single'
Dashes: - (hyphen)  -- (range 1--5)  --- (sentence dash)
Non-breaking space: Figure~1

items.title: LaTeX: inline and display math
items.body:
Inline: $E = mc^2$

Display:
\[ x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a} \]

Numbered equation:
\begin{equation}
  a^2 + b^2 = c^2
\end{equation}
items.description: Dollar signs for inline, environments for display.

Compile a LaTeX document
items.body:
